change.process: Staff questions at the counter of a 5 to 50 person family business: what is the price on this, do we take it back after thirty days, which supplier do we order that from. Today they are answered by walking over and asking Sam's dad.
change.friction: The answers and the hundred exceptions live in one person's head, so every new hire asks them again and nothing can be handed over. Everything is still managed the old-fashioned way, and the first useful milestone is not a tool at all, it is one process written down.
change.ai_boundary: The assistant answers only from the one written document, and it says 'ask Dad' when the answer is not in there instead of guessing. Prices are read off the price sheet and never written by the model. Nobody's job goes anywhere: this gives back the hours that get lost walking across the shop floor.
change.next_action: Comment MAP, write one process down this week, and run the counter the old way and the new way side by side before anything is switched off.
